mapper.sql: a.accessory_id, a.accessory_code, a.accessory_name, a.class_id, a.brand_id, concat_ws(' / ', parent_class.class_name, pc.class_name) as class_name, b.brand_name, a.specification, a.unit, a.description, a.status, a.is_delete, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark, (select count(1) from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_accessory_model` am where am.accessory_id = a.accessory_id and am.is_delete = 0) as model_count
mapper.select:
select from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_accessory` a inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_product_class` pc on pc.class_id = a.class_id and pc.class_level = 2 and pc.is_delete = 0 inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_product_class` parent_class on parent_class.class_id = pc.parent_id and parent_class.class_level = 1 and parent_class.is_delete = 0 left join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_brand` b on b.brand_id = a.brand_id and b.is_delete = 0 where a.is_delete = 0
and (a.accessory_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or a.accessory_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and a.status = #{status} and a.class_id = #{classId} and a.brand_id = #{brandId}
and exists (select 1 from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_accessory_model` compatible_model where compatible_model.accessory_id = a.accessory_id and compatible_model.model_id = #{modelId} and compatible_model.status = 0 and compatible_model.is_delete = 0)
order by a.create_time desc, a.accessory_id desc

select from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_accessory` a inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_product_class` pc on pc.class_id = a.class_id and pc.class_level = 2 and pc.is_delete = 0 inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_product_class` parent_class on parent_class.class_id = pc.parent_id and parent_class.class_level = 1 and parent_class.is_delete = 0 left join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_brand` b on b.brand_id = a.brand_id and b.is_delete = 0 where a.accessory_id = #{accessoryId} and a.is_delete = 0
select model_id from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_accessory_model` where accessory_id = #{accessoryId} and is_delete = 0 order by model_id

select a.accessory_id as accessoryId, a.accessory_code as accessoryCode, a.accessory_name as accessoryName, a.class_id as classId, a.brand_id as brandId, a.specification, a.unit, a.status from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_accessory` a where a.status = 0 and a.is_delete = 0 order by a.create_time desc, a.accessory_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_accessory` (accessory_code, accessory_name, class_id, brand_id, specification, unit, description, status, create_by, create_time, remark, is_delete) values (#{accessoryCode}, #{accessoryName}, #{classId}, #{brandId}, #{specification}, #{unit}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark}, 0)
mapper.update: update `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_accessory` set accessory_code = #{accessoryCode}, accessory_name = #{accessoryName}, class_id = #{classId}, brand_id = #{brandId}, specification = #{specification}, unit = #{unit}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where accessory_id = #{accessoryId} and is_delete = 0
mapper.insert: insert into `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_accessory_model` (accessory_id, model_id, compatibility_type, status, create_by, create_time, is_delete) values (#{accessoryId}, #{modelId}, 1, 0, #{operator}, sysdate(), 0) on duplicate key update is_delete = 0, status = 0, update_by = #{operator}
mapper.delete: delete deleted_model from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_accessory_model` deleted_model inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_accessory_model` active_model on active_model.accessory_id = deleted_model.accessory_id and active_model.model_id = deleted_model.model_id and active_model.is_delete = 0 where deleted_model.accessory_id = #{accessoryId} and deleted_model.is_delete = 1
mapper.update: update `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_accessory` set is_delete = 1, update_by = #{operator}, remove_by = #{operator}, remove_time = sysdate() where accessory_id = #{accessoryId} and is_delete = 0
